capabilities.need: Ask the user questions in rounds
capabilities.via: ask_user shows question cards (1 to 4 questions, 2 to 4 options each, one answer per question)
the user picks the project folder with the folder button; bash and the file tools work in it

capabilities.need: Show a file (reel, lab, cards, MP4)
capabilities.via: show_page opens an HTML or video file of the project or the skill in the preview pane

capabilities.need: Fill in the project questions and decide on assets on screens
capabilities.via: the Inspector (project parameters and global look) and the Resources tab of the Library, in the editing workspace; or one question per screen in a wizard (Beginner mode) that ends in the workspace; update_parameter and update_asset change them as plain cards the user accepts or refuses

the Look tab of the Library (looks, palettes, fonts, backgrounds, effects, scene transitions, each drawn in the Viewer by the same engine as the reel, with licence warnings for fonts) and the global look in the Inspector (palette editor with a contrast check); update_decision changes them as plain cards the user accepts or refuses

capabilities.need: Write the storyboard, review each scene and give the go on screens
capabilities.via: the Scenes tab of the Library (the scene library: create, edit, duplicate, archive; each scene has its own duration, a stable ID, linked resources and a review state), the Storyboard strip at the bottom (the order of the scenes, each switched on or off, drag to reorder, native reading-budget and feasibility checks) and the Inspector (review: OK, MODIFY or DITCH with a note; the Go button that only the user can press); add_scene, update_scene, enable_scene and move_scene propose changes as plain cards the user accepts or refuses

capabilities.need: Build the reel, test it and play it
capabilities.via: the Build and preview view of the workspace: after the Go, you write the vN folder (project.json and main.js); the app runs build.py, harness.js and smoke_player.js, shows each result in green or red, and plays vN/dist/index.html in the window; outputs stay in the project folder

capabilities.need: Let the user read and edit the project files next to the assistant
capabilities.via: an Advanced panel (off by default) shows the project's files with editors and a per-file history; propose_edit offers a change to a file as a diff the user accepts or refuses; get_state reads the project's state
screenshot_preview captures the preview pane (a page, a contact sheet or the reel, after show_page) as an image the model can look at

capabilities.fallback: no hosted pages: deliver the HTML file and say how to share it

capabilities.via: bash runs in a login shell in the project folder
numpy and ffmpeg when the owner ran the environment setup; the environment check reports what is missing

capabilities.fallback: no web search: ask the user for facts and documents; never invent figures
